# PROJ round trip

<!-- generated by report/projections.py from suites/projections/reference.json and engine results; do not edit -->

PROJ 9.10.0's inverse of its own forward result, against the input point, for every projection in the suite. A large value here is a question for PROJ, not for the ports: the ports are judged against PROJ's inverse, so this page checks that reference. Triage of what it raises: [proj-concerns.md](proj-concerns.md).
